verses.original: יֹ֭שֵׁב בְּסֵ֣תֶר עֶלְי֑וֹן בְּצֵ֥ל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְלוֹנָֽן׃
verses.literal: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty
verses.literalPt: AQUELE que habita no esconderijo do Altíssimo, à sombra do Onipotente descansará.

verses.original: אֹמַ֗ר לַֽ֭יהוָה מַחְסִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֑י אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֶבְטַח־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: I will say to the LORD You are my refuge and my fortress my God in whom I trust
verses.literalPt: Direi do SENHOR: Ele é o meu Deus, o meu refúgio, a minha fortaleza, e nele confiarei.

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַ֭צִּֽילְךָ מִפַּ֥ח יָק֗וּשׁ מִדֶּ֥בֶר הַוּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kî hū yaṣ·ṣî·lə·ḵā mip·paḥ yā·qūš mid·de·ḇer haw·wō·wṯ
verses.literal: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler and from the deadly plague
verses.literalPt: Porque ele te livrará do laço do passarinheiro, e da peste perniciosa.

verses.original: בְּאֶבְרָת֨וֹ׀ יָ֣סֶךְ לָ֭ךְ וְתַֽחַת־ כְּנָפָ֣יו תֶּחְסֶ֑ה צִנָּ֖ה וְֽסֹחֵרָ֣ה אֲמִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’eḇ·rā·ṯōw yā·seḵ lāḵ wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ- kə·nā·p̄āw teḥ·seh ṣin·nāh wə·sō·ḥê·rāh ’ă·mit·tōw
verses.literal: He will cover you with His feathers under His wings you will find refuge His faithfulness is a shield and rampart
verses.literalPt: Ele te cobrirá com as suas penas, e debaixo das suas asas te confiarás; a sua verdade será o teu escudo e broquel.

verses.original: לֹא־ תִ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד לָ֑יְלָה מֵ֝חֵ֗ץ יָע֥וּף יוֹמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯî·rā mip·pa·ḥaḏ lā·yə·lāh mê·ḥêṣ yā·‘ūp̄ yō·w·mām
verses.literal: You will not fear the terror of the night nor the arrow that flies by day
verses.literalPt: Não terás medo do terror de noite nem da seta que voa de dia,

verses.original: מִ֭דֶּבֶר בָּאֹ֣פֶל יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ מִ֝קֶּ֗טֶב יָשׁ֥וּד צָהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: mid·de·ḇer bā·’ō·p̄el ya·hă·lōḵ miq·qe·ṭeḇ yā·šūḏ ṣā·ho·rā·yim
verses.literal: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness nor the calamity that destroys at noon
verses.literalPt: Nem da peste que anda na escuridão, nem da mortandade que assola ao meio-dia.

verses.original: יִפֹּ֤ל מִצִּדְּךָ֨׀ אֶ֗לֶף וּרְבָבָ֥ה מִימִינֶ֑ךָ אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִגָּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: yip·pōl miṣ·ṣid·də·ḵā ’e·lep̄ ū·rə·ḇā·ḇāh mî·mî·ne·ḵā ’ê·le·ḵā lō yig·gāš
verses.literal: Though a thousand may fall at your side and ten thousand at your right hand no harm will come near you
verses.literalPt: Mil cairão ao teu lado, e dez mil à tua direita, mas não chegará a ti.

verses.original: רַ֭ק בְּעֵינֶ֣יךָ תַבִּ֑יט וְשִׁלֻּמַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: raq bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ṯab·bîṭ wə·šil·lu·maṯ rə·šā·‘îm tir·’eh
verses.literal: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked
verses.literalPt: Somente com os teus olhos contemplarás, e verás a recompensa dos ímpios.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן שַׂ֣מְתָּ מְעוֹנֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling my refuge the Most High
verses.literalPt: Porque tu, ó SENHOR, és o meu refúgio. No Altíssimo fizeste a tua habitação.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תְאֻנֶּ֣ה אֵלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝נֶ֗גַע לֹא־ יִקְרַ֥ב בְּאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯə·’un·neh ’ê·le·ḵā rā·‘āh wə·ne·ḡa‘ lō- yiq·raḇ bə·’ā·ho·le·ḵā
verses.literal: no evil will befall you no plague will approach your tent
verses.literalPt: Nenhum mal te sucederá, nem praga alguma chegará à tua tenda.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מַ֭לְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה־ לָּ֑ךְ לִ֝שְׁמָרְךָ֗ בְּכָל־ דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî mal·’ā·ḵāw yə·ṣaw·weh- lāḵ liš·mā·rə·ḵā bə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵe·ḵā
verses.literal: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways
verses.literalPt: Porque aos seus anjos dará ordem a teu respeito, para te guardarem em todos os teus caminhos.

verses.original: עַל־ כַּפַּ֥יִם יִשָּׂא֑וּנְךָ פֶּן־ תִּגֹּ֖ף בָּאֶ֣בֶן רַגְלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kap·pa·yim yiś·śā·’ū·nə·ḵā pen- tig·gōp̄ bā·’e·ḇen raḡ·le·ḵā
verses.literal: They will lift you up in their hands so that you will not strike your foot against a stone
verses.literalPt: Eles te sustentarão nas suas mãos, para que não tropeces com o teu pé em pedra.

verses.original: עַל־ שַׁ֣חַל וָפֶ֣תֶן תִּדְרֹ֑ךְ תִּרְמֹ֖ס כְּפִ֣יר וְתַנִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- ša·ḥal wā·p̄e·ṯen tiḏ·rōḵ tir·mōs kə·p̄îr wə·ṯan·nîn
verses.literal: You will tread on the lion and cobra you will trample the young lion and serpent
verses.literalPt: Pisarás o leão e a cobra; calcarás aos pés o filho do leão e a serpente.

verses.original: כִּ֤י בִ֣י חָ֭שַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ אֲ֝שַׂגְּבֵ֗הוּ כִּֽי־ יָדַ֥ע שְׁמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇî ḥā·šaq wa·’ă·p̄al·lə·ṭê·hū ’ă·śag·gə·ḇê·hū kî- yā·ḏa‘ šə·mî
verses.literal: Because he loves Me I will deliver him because he knows My name I will protect him
verses.literalPt: Porquanto tão encarecidamente me amou, também eu o livrarei; pô-lo-ei em retiro alto, porque conheceu o meu nome.

verses.original: יִקְרָאֵ֨נִי׀ וְֽאֶעֱנֵ֗הוּ עִמּֽוֹ־ אָנֹכִ֥י בְצָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלְּצֵ֗הוּ וַֽאֲכַבְּדֵֽהוּ׃
verses.literal: When he calls out to Me I will answer him I will be with him in trouble I will deliver him and honor him
verses.literalPt: Ele me invocará, e eu lhe responderei; estarei com ele na angústia; dela o retirarei, e o glorificarei.

verses.literal: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation
verses.literalPt: Fartá-lo-ei com longura de dias, e lhe mostrarei a minha salvação.
